About Midtec Associates/Since 1977/Shawnee, Kansas

Fifty years. One mission.

Independent manufacturers’ representatives for the Heart of America, since 1977.

1977

Our story

Built on experience, market knowledge, and showing up.

Since 1977, Midtec Associates has continued its growth strategy by building on a foundation of experience and market knowledge. We are a multi-line manufacturers’ representative specializing in electronic and electromechanical components, subsystems and complete system solutions.

“Our engineering sales approach has proven successful, with key design contacts inside every major account.”

What we are

A professional field sales organization that represents manufacturers with a high degree of ethics and professionalism.

What we are not

Not a distributor, and not a manufacturer. We are your line’s dedicated presence in Mid-America.

How we work

Responsive service, dependable partnerships, and direct market access for the principals we represent.

Leadership

The people on the line.

Memberships

Held to the standards of our industry.

Midtec is a member of the Electronics Representatives Association and the Manufacturers’ Agents National Association, the bodies that set the bar for professional representation.

Excellence in responsiveness and dependability for your brand.
